title_zh: Code2MCP：将代码仓库转换为MCP服务
one_line: A seven-agent pipeline converts a GitHub repository into an MCP service, repairing it from test tracebacks in a Run-Review-Fix loop.

code.quote: The code is public at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/Code2MCP.

S3.quote: at least three pre-identified, documentation-facing functionalities succeed under automatic invocation

S4.quote: The Review Agent analyzes together with the generated code, the Code Report, and the failing test, and diagnoses root causes such as logic errors, missing dependencies, or interface mismatches.

S6.quote: It leverages the DeepWiki tool to obtain a semantic view of the code and associates code entities with their intent from documentation and comments.

title_zh: Live-SWE-agent：软件工程智能体能否即时自我进化？
one_line: Minimal bash agent is prompted after each step to reflect and create custom tool scripts on the fly while solving one issue; no offline training.

F3.quote: autonomously evolves its own scaffold implementation while solving real-world software problems
